items.meta_description: Download VpnHood! CONNECT, the free open-source VPN, for Android, iOS, Windows, or Linux — from Google Play, the App Store, or as a direct download.
items.hero_desc: Free, secure, and open-source VPN with a global server network designed to protect your online privacy and ensure secure access to the web.
items.direct_link_note: It's best to download with the direct link only when you don't have access to Google Play.
items.windows_premium_note: The Windows version does not have any free servers, and you must upgrade to Premium to use it.
items.ios_premium_note: The iOS version does not have any free servers, and you must upgrade to Premium to use it.
items.linux_premium_note: The Linux version does not have any free servers, and you must upgrade to Premium to use it.
